passage.title: Seasonal Agricultural Work Available
passage.body:
Pekerja Musim Diperlukan

Kami mencari pekerja musim untuk kerja di ladang kami. Pekerjaan ini sementara dan membutuhkan keberadaan Anda dari pukul 7 pagi hingga 5 sore hari. Gaji yang ditawarkan Rp 75.000 per hari. Silakan datang ke kantor kami untuk informasi lebih lanjut.

items.stem: What does the notice say about the work?
items.explanation: The word "sementara" means 'temporary'. The notice says the work is "sementara" (temporary).
The notice says the work is "dibutuhkan untuk keberadaan" (needed for the presence). This means the work is necessary for something to be present, in this case, agricultural products.

passage.title: Community Center Adjustments
passage.body: Pusat Kegiatan Masyarakat akan melakukan perubahan jam operasional dan layanan terbatas mulai minggu depan. Perubahan ini dilakukan untuk membantu masyarakat lanjut usia yang menggunakan pusat kegiatan ini. Jam operasional baru akan dimulai dari pukul 8 pagi hingga 3 sore setiap hari. Kami harap perubahan ini dapat meningkatkan kenyamanan dan kenyamanan penggunaan pusat kegiatan masyarakat.

items.stem: What is the main reason for the changes at the community center?
choices: To better serve the elderly population
items.explanation: The text states that the changes are made to 'membantu masyarakat lanjut usia', which means 'to help the elderly population'. This is the main reason for the adjustments at the community center.
The text mentions 'layanan terbatas', which means 'limited services'. This indicates that not all services will be available due to the changes.

items.stem: Why is this message being shared?
choices: To announce a new community center
To advertise activities for young people
To inform about new community center hours
To request volunteers for the community center
items.explanation: The message is shared to inform the community about 'perubahan jam operasional', which means 'changes in operating hours'. This is the primary purpose of the announcement.

passage.title: New AI Guidelines
passage.body: Pemerintah akan mengeluarkan aturan baru untuk penggunaan kecerdasan buatan. Peraturan baru ini diusulkan untuk melindungi data pribadi warga dan mencegah penyalahgunaan teknologi. Semua perusahaan yang menggunakan kecerdasan buatan harus mematuhi peraturan baru ini. Informasi lebih lanjut akan diberikan dalam beberapa hari.

items.stem: What is the main topic of the message?
items.explanation: The message discusses 'aturan baru' (new regulations) for 'penggunaan kecerdasan buatan' (artificial intelligence usage), as stated in the first sentence of the text.
The word 'diusulkan' is used to indicate that the regulations are being suggested or proposed, as in 'aturan baru yang diusulkan' (new regulations that are proposed).

items.stem: What is the purpose of this message?
choices: To explain how to use AI
To discuss the history of AI
To inform about the dangers of AI
items.explanation: The purpose of the message is to announce 'aturan baru untuk penggunaan kecerdasan buatan' (new regulations for artificial intelligence usage), as stated in the first sentence of the text.
